description:
List the data sets defined on the active document (Image > Variables > Data Sets).

Use when: before applying data sets or debugging a data-driven template.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { datasets, active, count } }.
Preconditions: active document with variables/data sets defined.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool activates that document before running so a UI tab switch cannot retarget the edit.

name: photoshop_list_datasets
